title: DA-DeFi
tagline: A zk-rollup DeFi Dapp seamlessly integrated into the appchain
description: Experience the power of a zk-rollup DeFi platform seamlessly integrated into your own appchain, amplified by the benefits of a robust Data Availability layer. Enhance security, scalability, and efficiency while maintaining full control over your decentralized finance ecosystem. Join the forefront of decentralized innovation and take charge of your financial future with our cutting-edge solution, empowering you to navigate the complexities of the digital economy with ease.
how_its_made: The DA-DeFi platform is running on the Madara/Karnot appchain, offering a secure and scalable foundation for decentralized finance operations. With Avail as the data availability layer, it brings transparency and reliability, ensuring seamless access to the transactions  and data within the ecosystem.
